specs.keyboard_notes: Per-key RGB, no TrackPoint; keys not centered on numpad

battery.notes: 99.9Wh. RTINGS measured sub-5h browsing on the OLED config; IPS tier marginally more efficient.

price.notes: BBY API 2026-11-24: regular $8,289 / sale $5,799 (marketplace seller, online only).

offers.name: Lenovo Legion Pro 7 16" WQXGA Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - NVIDIA RTX 5080 - Windows 11 Pro - Black

reviews.quote: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i is excellent for gaming. Our RTX 5080 configuration achieves high frame rates across demanding games, including titles with ray tracing.
The Legion Pro 7i has disappointing battery life. The RTX 5080 configuration lasts under five hours while browsing the web.

praises: 32GB is the right amount of RAM from the factory for gaming plus Discord, browser, and streaming in the background
Same solid all-aluminum chassis and 175W RTX 5080 as every Pro 7 tier — no performance compromise
IPS panel avoids OLED burn-in anxiety for static taskbars and HUDs while staying fast at 240Hz
Two M.2 slots and SODIMMs keep it genuinely serviceable — add a second drive cheaply
Anti-glare IPS handles office and daytime-window use better than the glossy OLED
complaints: Pay $400 more than the 16GB SKU for RAM you could install yourself for a fraction of that
IPS blacks and backlight bleed are a clear step down from the OLED tier in dark rooms
Line-wide reports of RTX 5080 TDR/nvlddmkm black-screen crashes on some units
Fans audibly loud in Performance mode; keyboard deck heat noticeable during long gaming sessions
Roughly 4-5h real-world battery — this is a plugged-in machine with a 400W brick

design_philosophy: The sensible IPS middle build of Lenovo's flagship 16-inch gaming line: full 175W RTX 5080 and Core Ultra 9 in the all-aluminum chassis with a practical 32GB of RAM, trading the OLED's contrast for a lower price and matte panel. Aimed at gamers who want flagship power without paying for the panel upgrade.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from RTINGS' reviewed OLED RTX 5080 config (8.7) per SHARED-legion-pro7.md deltas: IPS panel → screen_quality -1.0, readability_dark -1.5, readability_bright +0.3, battery +0.2; 32GB RAM matches the anchor so productivity/ai_ml unchanged. Refresh not stated in BBY title; assumed 240Hz per line standard (other 275HX SKUs list 240Hz).
